domain(person,[crew]).

% Crew does not know biology.
axiom(s1, not(knows_biology(crew))).

% If Crew either rescues amphibians or researches marine life (but not both), then he studies axolotls.
axiom(s2, rule([xor(rescues_amphibians(crew), researches_marine_life(crew))], studies_axolotls(crew))).

% If Crew loves aquatic life, then he will study axolotls.
axiom(s3, rule([loves_aquatic_life(crew)], studies_axolotls(crew))).

% Crew does not have a passion for nature.
axiom(s4, not(has_passion_for_nature(crew))).

% If someone cares for animals and understands ecology, then they can advocate for conservation.
axiom(s5, rule([cares_for_animals(X), understands_ecology(X)], advocates_for_conservation(X))).

% Anyone who enjoys scuba diving and appreciates marine life will love aquatic life.
axiom(s6, rule([enjoys_scuba_diving(X), appreciates_marine_life(X)], loves_aquatic_life(X))).

% For all humans, if they value wildlife and help endangered species, then they care for animals.
axiom(s7, forall(var(x,person), implies(and(values_wildlife(var(x)), helps_endangered_species(var(x))), cares_for_animals(var(x))))).

% Crew helps endangered species.
axiom(s8, helps_endangered_species(crew)).

% If Crew studies axolotls, then he either establishes a sanctuary or advocates for their conservation, but not both.
axiom(s9, rule([studies_axolotls(crew)], xor(establishes_sanctuary(crew), advocates_for_conservation(crew)))).

% Crew knows biology or understands ecology.
axiom(s10, or(knows_biology(crew), understands_ecology(crew))).

% Crew values wildlife.
axiom(s11, values_wildlife(crew)).

% Crew has a passion for nature or loves aquatic life.
axiom(s12, or(has_passion_for_nature(crew), loves_aquatic_life(crew))).
